subject: SLA / Order form: bespoke retention windows & deletion timelines (Acme)
content:

Cc: security@acme-cloud.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Data residency & retention: order form questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement/security are working through the order form and we have a few specific questions on data residency, retention, and deletion that need explicit SLA language before we can sign: 

1) Can Redwood support region pinning to us-west-2 for both inference and backups for our account?
2) We need bespoke retention windows per environment (sandbox: 30 days, prod: 7 years) — is that supported in the order form?
3) Deletion timeline on contract termination: our legal wants a guaranteed timeline for primary data deletion and a separate timeline for backups/archives. They suggested: primary deletion within 45 days, backups purged within 180 days, and a certificate of deletion. Is that acceptable?
4) Is there any price delta for extended retention (prod > 365 days)? If so, ballpark numbers would help to speed approvals.
5) SOC2 artifact or snapshot for 2025 — can you share?

If easier, we can take a 30-minute call with your solutions and legal teams.

Regards,
Jorge Ortega
Head of Cloud Security, Acme Cloud

Hi Jorge — thanks for writing this up and for the clear asks. I looped in Priyom (solutions) and Rachel (legal) so we can surface precise order-form language. Initial notes below; Priyom/Rachel — please confirm or correct.

High level answers:
- Region pinning: yes, we can pin inference and primary storage to a US region (we commonly use us-west-2). Backups can be configured to remain in the same region or a paired region depending on your preference.
- Bespoke retention windows: supported — we model retention per data-class and per environment. We can add environment-specific retention windows to the Order Form / SOW.
- Deletion timelines: we support a primary deletion plus a backup purge window. Standard timeline is primary deletion within 30 days and backup purges within 90 days; we can negotiate bespoke timelines (45/180) with corresponding order-form language and potential pricing adjustments.
- Price impact: extended retention (multi-year) typically incurs an incremental storage fee and occasionally a one-time migration/ingestion cost if we need to slice historical data from cold storage into a separate retention tier. Priyom — can you add ballpark numbers?

I attached a near-final draft of the Order Form with placeholders for the retention section (RM_OrderForm_Draft.pdf).

If it helps, we can schedule a brief call tomorrow to run through the exact wording.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Data residency & retention: order form questions

Thanks Jorge — quick technical clarifications from our side: 

- Region pinning: we can schedule deployment/placement to us-west-2 for compute and primary object storage. Backups are stored in the same region by default; we can opt into cross-region replication on request.
- Data classes: we typically include (1) inference request logs (metadata + prompts), (2) model-derived outputs, (3) customer-provided artifacts (files uploaded), (4) operational logs (metrics/traces). Retention is configurable per class.
- Retention proposals: sandbox 30 days — straightforward; production 7 years — supported but will require allocation to our long-term retention tier.
- Deletion semantics: on a certified deletion request (termination or offboarding), we perform: (A) data marking & primary deletion workflow (truncate pointers, scrub object indices) — target window 30–45 days depending on size and export requests; (B) backup/archive lifecycle transitions — backups are immutable copies taken for business continuity; we can purge these within an agreed window (90–180 days) and provide an attestation of purge completion.
- Certificate of deletion: we can provide a signed attestation (PDF) once the purge job completes. It will reference the account id, object manifests purged, retention policy applied, and timestamp of purge completion.

Ballpark pricing: for prod retention > 365 days we typically bill $0.02–$0.05 per GB/month depending on tiering and retrieval SLAs, plus a one-time $1,500–$7,500 migration fee for material volumes (depends on TBs and required reorganizations). I can give a more exact estimate if you share projected TBs.

Attachment: SOC2_Snapshot_2025.pdf (SOC 2 type II summary snapshot)

Best,
Priyom Das

Hi Jorge / Acme team —

Thanks — we can commit to bespoke timelines as follows, and will reflect the exact text below in the redlined Order Form I attached. If this looks acceptable, I will generate the DocuSign packet and routing.

Proposed SLA / Order Form language (retention & deletion):

1) Data residency: Redwood Inference will provision primary compute and object storage for the Account in the US-West-2 (Oregon) region. Backups will be stored in the same region by default. Cross-region replication will only occur if the Account requests and pays for cross-region replication in the Order Form.

2) Retention windows by environment: 
  - Sandbox: 30 days for inference logs and artifacts.
  - Production: 7 years for customer-specified production artifacts where specified in the Order Form; otherwise, default production retention is 365 days.

3) Certified deletion on termination or written request: 
  - Primary data deletion: Redwood will delete primary data (including inference logs, model outputs, and customer artifacts stored in primary object storage) within 45 calendar days of a certified deletion request.
  - Backup purge: Redwood will purge backups and archival copies of the Account’s data within 180 calendar days of the certified deletion request. Backups are immutable copies made for business continuity.
  - Certificate of Deletion: Upon completion of the backup purge, Redwood will provide a signed Certificate of Deletion (PDF) that includes: account identifier, list of data classes purged, retention policy applied, date/time of purge completion, and signature of an authorized Redwood officer.

4) Pricing: Extended retention beyond 365 days will be billed at an additional storage rate, and extended retention configuration may incur a one-time setup/migration fee. Pricing specifics will be appended to the Order Form as a schedule once Acme confirms expected data volume and access characteristics.

Attachment: RM_OrderForm_Acme_Retention_Redlines.pdf (redline reflecting the language above)

Next steps: if Acme confirms the text, I’ll send the DocuSign link for final signatures and include the adjusted pricing schedule. If you’d like a 20-minute review with legal and solutions before signatures, we can book that too.
